description: This source file contains helper functions for voice wake trigger processing and locale normalization, used within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: sanitizeVoiceWakeTriggers
methods.description: Processes an array of words to clean and truncate them according to wake word parameters, providing default triggers if input is empty.

methods.name: normalizeLocaleIdentifier
methods.description: Normalizes a locale string by removing specific parts such as '@' annotations and regional tags, producing a standardized locale identifier.
